<a name="animate"></a>

## animate(element, [options]) ⇒ <code>Promise.&lt;MotionResult&gt;</code>
Animate an existing shell, restoring its inline motion properties, attributes,
and class on completion or cancellation. Exit retains data-ms-exited="true";
entry clears it. Missing styles or suppressed animation use a timing fallback.
Running phases emit ms:start and ms:finish; skipped phases emit neither event.

**Kind**: global function<br>
**Returns**: <code>Promise.&lt;MotionResult&gt;</code> - Finished, cancelled, or skipped status.<br>
**Throws**:

- <code>TypeError</code> When the target or easing is invalid.
- <code>RangeError</code> When a preset, direction, phase, duration, or delay is invalid.


| Param | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| element | <code>HTMLElement</code> \| <code>SVGElement</code> |  | Target shell; wrap component transforms. |
| [options] | <code>MotionOptions</code> | <code>{}</code> | Preset, phase, direction, timing, and easing. |
